"**Backup always uses the FIRST width encoded features of the epoch, frozen once available.**"

Consider: the epoch has consumed 5 packets (width=3) → backup features = the first 3 ✓. If the epoch has consumed 1 packet (width=3) → features = [f0, 1514, 1514] ✓ ("right-pad a shorter prefix with 1514").
